_doc: Arena 9 (retail world 40: ruins with iron railings) kit for the map editor (S36); it also holds arena 11's (world 42) broken paving and arena 10's (world 41) drain, made with their arena 9 groups, same schema as art/arena7/kit.json. The stone reuses the arena 6 loom textures. Pieces the arena also uses from the other kits are found by map_sheet.py.

drain: hierro con verdín, cobre, limo verde
torch: madera clara, hierro y púas doradas
madera rojiza y púas de cobre

pieces.name: pebbles
pieces.label: Roquitas
pieces.note: a lump, a sharp chip and three crumbs of the pale ruin stone; 1413 and 2174 are the same scatter

pieces.name: pebbles_spread
pieces.label: Roquitas esparcidas
pieces.note: eight pebbles spread across the cell: lumps, a shard, crumbs

pieces.name: stone_shards
pieces.label: Lascas de piedra
pieces.note: sharp stone shards, one long split shard and a dark one

pieces.name: stone_flake
pieces.label: Trozo de losa
pieces.note: a broken flagstone in two pieces with a flake on it and a dark wedge

pieces.name: pebbles_few
pieces.label: Roquitas sueltas
pieces.note: a few crumbs: a sharp chip, a darker lump

pieces.name: slab_chips
pieces.label: Laja con roquitas
pieces.note: a flat slab of greyer, faintly pink stone with three round pebbles at its left end

pieces.name: broken_slab
pieces.label: Losa rota
pieces.note: a pale flag broken into a big worn plate, a split one and two slivers

pieces.name: broken_slab_split
pieces.label: Losa rota en tres
pieces.note: two worn flags side by side, a thicker broken block in front and a lump behind

pieces.name: cracked_paving
pieces.label: Losa de piedra rota
pieces.note: arena 11's brown paving: three sharp flat stones among dark cracks in the ground

pieces.name: cracked_paving_left
pieces.label: Losa de piedra rota (izquierda)
pieces.note: the same, the big stone further left

pieces.name: cracked_paving_bits
pieces.label: Losa de piedra rota en trozos
pieces.note: three small brown stones round two cracks

pieces.name: cracked_paving_long
pieces.label: Losa de piedra rota larga
pieces.note: a long brown stone and a short one with a crack between them

pieces.name: sewer_grate
pieces.label: Alcantarilla
pieces.note: a square stone frame filling the cell round a mossy hole, two iron bars across; lies on a floor block

pieces.name: blood_drain
pieces.label: Desagüe
pieces.note: arena 10: a round brass-rimmed drain at the end of the blood river, one bar across

pieces.name: war_axe
pieces.label: Hacha de guerra
pieces.note: about 2.4 m, stuck upright in the floor, leaning a little; crescent blade, hammer block, wrapped haft

pieces.name: butcher_axe
pieces.label: Hacha clavada en la mesa
pieces.note: arena 10: its edge sunk in a table's top along x, the haft rising towards the back

pieces.name: butcher_axe_wall
pieces.label: Hacha clavada en la pared
pieces.note: arena 10: the wall is the plane x = 0 facing +x; the edge sunk upright in it, the haft straight out; y = 0 is the floor

pieces.name: wall_torch
pieces.label: Antorcha de pared (apagada)
pieces.note: an unlit cresset fixed high on a pillar's corner; y = 0 is its tip, the bracket goes back (-x -z) to the wall; about 0.95 m

pieces.name: round_shield
pieces.label: Escudo redondo
pieces.note: a domed bronze shield about 0.8 m across, standing on its rim and leaning well back (55°) (top to -z) against a wall or pillar, its face to +z

pieces.name: rock_chunks
pieces.label: Trozo de roca
pieces.note: four pale lumps 0.2-0.4 m and a crumb, whiter than the pebbles

pieces.name: coiled_whip
pieces.label: Látigo recogido
pieces.note: a coiled whip hung from a peg on a wall: the wall is the plane x = 0 facing +x; y = 0 is the floor; about 1.4 m
